name: Amazon Seller Central (UK)
description: The control panel where you register as a seller, create listings, manage FBA inventory, run PPC, and monitor account health.

name: Amazon Seller Signup (UK)
description: The correct UK signup entry point so your home marketplace is Amazon.co.uk, not .com.

name: Amazon Brand Registry
description: Amazon's brand-protection programme you enrol in once your trademark is registered, unlocking A+ Content, Brand Story, Vine, and hijacker reporting.

name: Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfilment (MCF)
description: Amazon service that ships your existing FBA inventory to fulfil orders from other channels such as eBay.

name: Helium 10
description: Amazon research suite whose free X-Ray extension gives sales/BSR estimates and whose Cerebro tool is used for keyword research.

name: Chrome Web Store
description: Where you install the free Helium 10 browser extension for product research.

name: SellerApp Description Editor
description: Free web tool that converts a plain-text product description into Amazon-compatible HTML for pasting into Seller Central.

name: ChatGPT
description: AI assistant used to draft optimised listing titles, bullets, and descriptions from a keyword list before editing them down.

name: Claude
description: AI assistant cited as an alternative to ChatGPT for drafting listing copy against the course's structured prompts.

name: Gemini
description: Google's AI assistant, another option for drafting and refining listing titles, bullets, and descriptions from your keyword list.

name: Canva
description: Free design tool for building Amazon listing images and infographics and creating a simple brand logo/wordmark.

name: Looka
description: AI logo generator suggested as a low-cost option for creating a brand wordmark.

name: Fiverr
description: Freelance marketplace where you can pay a small fee for a clean logo or wordmark once your brand has proven itself.

name: GoDaddy
description: Domain registrar mentioned as an option for securing the brand's web domain.

name: GOV.UK: Set up a Limited Company
description: Official UK portal for registering a limited company so you can operate as a legitimate brand and open trade accounts.

name: Companies House: Name Check
description: UK register to check whether a proposed brand/company name is already taken before forming your Ltd.

name: GOV.UK: Register a Trade Mark
description: Official UK Intellectual Property Office route to file the trademark required for Amazon Brand Registry.

name: GOV.UK: Search for a Trade Mark
description: Free UK trademark search to confirm your proposed brand name is unique before filing.

name: HMRC
description: UK tax authority you engage with for the Amazon tax interview, Corporation Tax, and self-assessment.

name: UPS
description: Amazon's primary UK partnered carrier for inbound FBA shipments, with discounted rates and Access Point drop-offs.

name: DPD
description: One of Amazon's UK partnered carriers you can book at a discounted rate to ship boxes into FBA.

name: Avery
description: Maker of L7160-compatible adhesive label sheets used to print FNSKU labels for FBA units.

name: eBay UK
description: Second sales channel to expand to first, listing the same bundles via a business account and optionally fulfilling through Amazon MCF.

name: TikTok Shop (UK Seller)
description: Social-commerce channel for visual, impulse-buy products using creator and live-shopping content.

name: Shopify
description: E-commerce platform for building the brand's own website once you have a loyal, direct customer base.

name: Starling Bank
description: Business bank account option to keep company finances separate and match your Amazon account name.

name: Monzo Business
description: Business banking option for the new limited company once it is formed.

name: Tide
description: Business banking provider for separating business income and simplifying bookkeeping.

name: Revolut Business
description: Business banking option for paying suppliers and receiving Amazon payouts.
